title: Metodbox AI
summary: The AI assistant of the Metodbox education platform. It answers from about 65,000 videos and 30,000+ books, serves several institutions, and acts on the platform: teachers create content with it, and students are taken to the right place from their questions.

title: Uğurlu Asistan
summary: The customer-service assistant on the Uğur Okulları website. It answers school and campus questions, fills in contact and pre-registration forms in the chat, shows parents their purchases, and passes the conversation to the right support team when asked.

title: Tercih TV
summary: An AI-based platform that helps students choose universities after the YKS exam. I built parts of the backend and the whole AI part: recommendations from the student's scores, preference-list building, and reading scores from a photo of the exam result.

title: TercihBot
summary: A platform that helps 8th-grade students choose their high school after the LGS exam. I built parts of the backend and the whole AI chatbot, which works with the student's data and builds their preference list.

title: bkai
summary: An LLM service that generates educational questions, images and content for teachers. I am building its next version, with versioned and regenerable results and queued jobs on AWS Lambda, and moving it to Kubernetes on AWS EKS.

title: Notification System
summary: Notifications for the Metodbox and Uğur Dijital platforms: more than 60 instant and scheduled types, delivered to web and mobile.

title: Seçenek Admin Panel
summary: The admin panel of an exam-preparation platform, built from scratch as microservices: users and roles, reports and refunds, and curriculum and package management.

title: PayFlex (ATS) Web Pages
summary: Full-stack pages for a receivables-tracking product, today PayFlex, with Cucumber test suites for its web services.

title: Twitter API Streaming System
summary: A fault-tolerant streaming system that feeds the QOSHE news platform from the Twitter API.
